freeze_semantics: Content-hash freeze of the aider adapter's output over the conformance scenario at harness 0.82.0. aider uses the preprocess path: preprocess_aider.py parses the native markdown transcript (.aider.chat.history.md) — aider's only complete source — into one container, which aider.dsl.yaml turns into one trace. verify.py re-runs preprocess+DSL on each input (cwd = this dir, input paths relative) and asserts trace_count, per-trace content_hash, and unmapped_path_count; the drift_watch self-test asserts annotated_cells_fired equals the aider CELL_SIGNALS extractor. aider traces carry no provenance.source_path, so the content_hash is checkout-independent. First IMAGE rung and the older end of aider's release-delta; the candidate is the 0.86.2 fresh capture.
capture_provenance: Live container capture on the arm64 capture workstation (2026-07-25) via the version-pinned image miniobserve/aider-capture:0.82.0 (aider from pip aider-chat==0.82.0), routed to the arm64 capture workstation's ollama (qwen3:8b) via OLLAMA_API_BASE=host.docker.internal:11434 (aider/litellm reads it directly — no socat). --no-auto-commits, HOME=/workspace. Scenario s1-edit: 'Add a line delta to data.txt, then create summary.txt containing just the number of lines in data.txt' — exercises MODIFY (data.txt existed in the seed commit) + NEW (summary.txt created), so the rung fires cells 6 and 7 both. Host aider untouched.
